history: always repro'd across v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 -- 20/20 catalogued stable releases, every one a 60s timeout, no invalid probes; the SROA bail-out responsible dates to 6ee4074a4, the repository's first commit (2016-12-28), so it predates every probeable release
summary: Reproduces on everything measured. All 20 stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 hang unboundedly on the shader as filed (v1.9.2607 still running after 600s, at cpu/elapsed = 1.00 throughout -- a spin, not a blocked wait); the Debug ground truth does not hang but asserts in ~1s with 0xE0000001. Same defect: SROA_Helper::RewriteBitCast bails at the !SrcTy->isStructTy() guard (ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp:2661-2663) without erasing the bitcast or nulling the use, so RewriteForScalarRepl's while (!V->use_empty()) loop at 2991 never advances; both that assert and the DXASSERT that names the loop (2994-2996, 'Infinite loop while SROA'ing value, use isn't getting eliminated.') are NDEBUG-only, so Release just spins. Reduced to a struct with a struct-typed data member whose member function returns an array -- no ByteAddressBuffer, no register binding. Only one of the report's three stated conditions (the array return) is load-bearing; the other two variants still hang. The reporter's struct-return workaround still works, and hlsl_clang_trunk compiles all of it cleanly.
title: Compiler infinite loop issue
